layout.title: DiaVision | Diabetes Risk Predictor
layout.description: A secure, user-friendly diabetes risk assessment tool utilizing advanced statistical models to provide personalized insights.

page.heading: DiaVision - Diabetes Risk Predictor
page.intro: This tool evaluates your potential risk for developing type 2 diabetes using an advanced statistical approach. By analyzing the complex, real-world relationships between your different health metrics, it provides a highly personalized risk estimate. Please remember: this tool is strictly for educational purposes and does NOT replace professional medical diagnosis, testing, or consultation.

simple.title: Guided Assessment
simple.copy: Our streamlined questionnaire guides you through entering essential health metrics and recent lab results smoothly.

personalized.title: Data-Driven Insights
personalized.copy: Receive a clear, visual summary of potential risk factors and general recommendations to discuss with your physician.

private.title: Strictly Confidential
private.copy: Your health data is processed securely in real-time. We do not store or share your sensitive medical information.

comprehensive.title: Advanced Algorithm
comprehensive.copy: Unlike standard calculators, our predictive model evaluates exactly how your multiple physiological factors interact together, giving you a much more holistic view of your health.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: This application provides statistical risk estimates for educational purposes only. It is NOT a diagnostic tool. Do not alter any medications, diet, or health routines based on these results. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for clinical diagnosis and medical advice.

welcome.label: Welcome
welcome.title: Preliminary Health Screening
welcome.description: Take a few minutes to complete this questionnaire. Remember, this provides a statistical estimate using advanced data analysis and does not serve as a clinical evaluation.

quick.title: Efficient
quick.copy: Input your basic physiological metrics and latest fasting lab results.

smart.title: Smart Algorithm
smart.copy: Our model processes your inputs to generate a personalized risk probability based on complex data relationships.

holistic.title: Multivariate Approach
holistic.copy: Observe how metrics like BMI, age, and blood glucose interact simultaneously rather than one by one.

tips: Use your most recent fasting lab results (glucose, insulin) for optimal accuracy.
If you have never been pregnant, simply enter 0.
If you lack specific measurements (like skin thickness), enter 0. The system will apply statistically safe baseline averages.
Family history score helps the model account for genetic predispositions.
welcome.tipsFooter: Please note: This assessment is strictly for informational purposes and cannot substitute for a professional clinical diagnosis.

profile.label: About You
profile.title: Baseline Demographics
profile.description: Provide your foundational metrics. Age and body composition are critical variables in metabolic assessments.
profile.ageDescription: Enter your current age in years.
profile.bmiDescription: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a key indicator of metabolic health.
profile.sidebarBody: Age, overall weight proportion, and specific health history are primary baseline factors used by predictive models to evaluate diabetes risk.

labs.label: Health Numbers
labs.title: Recent Laboratory Results
labs.description: Enter your most recent clinical readings. These numbers are highly correlated with metabolic function.
labs.bloodPressureDescription: Enter your systolic (top) blood pressure reading.

measurements.label: More Details
measurements.title: Advanced Metrics
measurements.description: Additional physiological data increases the model's accuracy. Leave as 0 if these are unknown to you.
measurements.skinDescription: Triceps skinfold thickness. Enter 0 if unknown.

asideMissing.title: Missing Information?
asideMissing.copy: If you do not have certain lab values, enter 0. The algorithm will automatically adjust using standard population means.

asideConnecting.title: Connecting the Dots
asideConnecting.copy: Unlike basic calculators, our system evaluates the hidden dependencies between all your metrics, giving you a much smarter risk profile.
